candidate_family_adjudication.reason: Legitimate PBP definition exists but redundant with turnover rate and accepted Oracle QB interception rate in simple V1; no implementation authorized.
Legitimate PBP definition exists but sparse and redundant with turnover rate; no implementation authorized.

Weekly/frozen EPA totals, CPOE, attempts/carries/yards, and scoring history preserved for audit/cross-check only; PBP rates or Oracle interface are the selected canonical V1 representations (avoids duplicate representations).
Frozen snap counts, prior eligible games only, could support a future participation proxy but is player-selection-dependent; no stable totals aggregation selected.
No accepted pregame historical timestamp semantics for injuries/depth; would risk postgame/batch leakage.
Nullable qb_hit 0/1 is a legitimate hit proxy but excluded for redundancy; never pressure/hurry. If ever enabled name must be qb_hits_per_dropback / qb_hits_allowed_per_dropback.
No legitimate source field; qb_hit is only a named proxy; must not mislabel a proxy as pressure/hurry.
Schedule/PBP temp and wind are realized historical results, not pregame predictors; result-derived context prohibited.
